execution.description: Built the Test Lead's items 2-4 after the selective-crash probe: Graphite records no longer headline an ineligible set's soft score (v2 records, v1 read as written); a missing prediction is a schema-gate failure on battery's Graphite rule and refused by battery's validator; battery's Level 0 adapter gained selective_fault and prediction_omission run through both real paths, with mutations per host.

expected: Every host would charge a missing prediction and the omission probes would hold on both Challenges.
observed: Battery holds on every probe and host. Cooling's two hosts were not changed: the edit to the cooling scoring adapter was refused as a shared-resource change, so cooling's missing_prediction_attribution seam stays open pending its owners, and the record-level attribution hook was likewise not built. Battery's validator already refused an absent case; a null one was the hole.
keep: Put a coverage rule in one shared helper whose empty prediction fails the Challenge's own schema gate, so no exam or science module changes and track_a's byte pin holds.
Version a record whose meaning changes and read old versions through one helper, never by rewriting them.
Memoise only a deterministic step the probe does not test when a real path is too slow to run per attack, and say so.
change: Coverage edits in files another session owns need that owner or the owner's permission first; plan those hunks as notes, not edits.
Motor gets both probes once its scorer exists.
